name: embedable-chat-agent
description: Embeddable LLM chat agent with MCP support

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.setup: cp config.example.yaml config.yaml && cd backend && cp .env.example .env && echo 'Setup complete! Edit config.yaml and backend/.env with your settings.'
